lastCompletedStory.title: Reduce cam-ship.md to a thin phase-signal and record the ADR

openQuestions: This was the last story (priority 6) in the CAM-149 PRD; all 6 stories now have passes:true. The PRD is complete and ready for the review cycle / ship phase (this project's own dogfooded runShipPhase/runShipPrStep pipeline this PRD just built will run the ship for CAM-149 itself).

src/ui/Dashboard.tsx's keybar 's' key still sends a literal '/cam-ship' via tmux send-keys directly (noted as an open question in the US-005 handoff too). Re-verified in US-006: this is NOT a bug needing a fix. Both dispatch mechanisms now converge correctly: the CLI path (cam ship) writes phase:shipping directly; the slash-command path (Dashboard.tsx's 's' key -> '/cam-ship' -> orchestrator reads the now-thinned cam-ship.md) also ends up writing phase:shipping, then narrates. The reduced cam-ship.md documents exactly this convergence. No follow-up needed unless a future story wants to collapse the two mechanisms into one code path for its own sake (not a correctness issue).
nextStoryContext: No user stories remain in scripts/cam/prd.json for the CAM-149 PRD (all 6 have passes:true). The next agent invocation should find zero non-operator passes:false stories and should NOT implement anything: it should read prd.json, find nothing pending, and exit PRD_COMPLETE so the orchestrator/sidecar proceeds to /cam-review. If a new PRD has been planned by the time this handoff is read (e.g. via /cam-plan for a follow-up issue), ignore this file's CAM-149-specific context entirely and follow the new prd.json instead; this handoff carries no forward instructions for a different PRD.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-006 is a pure internal doc/refactor story: it thins two markdown command prompts (templates/commands/cam-ship.md, .claude/commands/cam-ship.md), writes a new architecture-decision-record markdown file (docs/adr/0009), regenerates the embedded vendor bundle (an internal build step, src/vendor/_generated.ts), rewrites a bun:test regression-guard test file, and fixes two stale cross-references in docs/recovery-runbook.md. No new external library API surface was introduced or exercised; the underlying gh/git behavior these docs describe was already implemented (and doc-validated) in US-001/002/003 of this same PRD.
